# Copilot project instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for shared project decisions and verification commands.
Use [the development guide](../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) for the current architecture.
The developer is learning React: explain each meaningful change with a short example
from the affected code. Keep the WF Template and its existing router.

Reusable workflows are in `.agents/skills`. Read the relevant SKILL.md for a request
to implement a feature with explanation, review changes, or diagnose a failing test.
Use the existing package versions. Check local documentation and installed package
types/source first, then configured internal documentation services. External
documentation is an explicitly enabled fallback, not a prerequisite for development.
Do not send private source, configuration, or credentials to external docs services.
